title: P-256 sigma rho: main-phase control repriced to 192 against the itemised 105 bound, cost side only

claims.statement: For uniform full-size P-256 Q=[x]P, the cold classical algorithm in proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.39 under the disclosed H1, M1/L-ori conditional fresh-exposure and H3 pricing premises. Total charged work is at most 2^127.007263 units at C=1000 scalar AArch64 instructions/unit. The complete inherited walk uses A=2^24, K=2^32, theta=2^-60, tau=0.4943026 and residual Markov factor 400000. All preprocessing, failures, restarts, table initialization, lookup, transfers, replay, verification and output are included. A specified 128-bit main-phase control wrapper costs at most 192 instructions per full batch round; finishing rounds retain 1024. The itemised listing bounds recurring main control at 105 (15-instruction normal path plus save/restore, stack, setup and handoff allowances), so 192 retains 87 headroom. The batch kernel's products with a register factor below p use five-word Montgomery rows, its hot backward rounds run as one register-resident assembly block, earlier cuts removed redundant loads and constants (-21 instructions per walk step, then -2 hoisted constants), the DP test is one EXTR+TST test, and anchor rounds run the same register block with a 19-instruction anchor tail; common work uses the measured plain round (46,832,918 per 2^16 walks), the measured anchor round (47,242,860) with a retained 164,560-instruction conservative margin, and this control charge. The table uses (key>>84) mod C and a separately charged bias debit; its eager zeroing is included. Peak memory is below 2^77 bytes, preprocessing at most 2^62.848069 units, and nonuniform advice zero. The conditional success margin remains at least 1e-7 above 0.39. Production probability and universal instruction bounds remain heuristic premises, not certifications. Measurements and finite experiments retain their original scope and attribution.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the revised full production cost ledger and order certificate, then run the inherited complete reduced-order procedure at tau=0.4943, the production value on its 0.0001 grid, retaining failures and replay checks. The two results have distinct scopes; neither establishes production mixing.
